gbm_population_evidence.quote: are eligible if the tumors are biopsied and proven to be high-grade gliomas (such as anaplastic astrocytoma, glioblastoma, high-grade glioma not otherwise specified \[NOS\], and/or H3 K27M-mutant) by institutional diagnosis.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is named in the inclusion criteria only as an example of HGG within the (now closed) pontine DIPG stratum; otherwise the trial is paediatric HGG/DIPG, and adults >=18 with H3K27-wildtype HGG are excluded, so it could be coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Selinexor (other names: ATG-010, CRM1 Nuclear Export Inhibitor KPT-330, KPT 330, KPT-330, KPT330, Nexpovio, Selective Inhibitor of Nuclear Export KPT-330, SINE KPT-330, Xpovio): Given orally

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: STEP 1: Patients must have newly-diagnosed DIPG or HGG (including DMG).

role_evidence.quote: This phase I/II trial tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of selinexor given in combination with standard radiation therapy

agents.drug_class_hint: XPO1/CRM1 selective inhibitor of nuclear export (approved for multiple myeloma)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Selinexor blocks a protein called CRM1, which may help keep cancer cells from growing and may kill them.

source_quote.quote: Patients must have newly-diagnosed non-pontine H3 K27M-mutant HGG without BRAF V600 or IDH1 mutations as confirmed by Rapid Central Pathology and Molecular Screening Reviews performed on APEC14B1
Patients must have newly-diagnosed non-pontine H3 K27M-wild type HGG without BRAF V600 or IDH1 mutations as confirmed by Rapid Central Pathology and Molecular Screening Reviews performed on APEC14B1
Patients must have newly-diagnosed non-pontine H3 K27M-wild type HGG without BRAF V600 or IDH1 mutations as confirmed by Rapid Central Pathology and Molecular Screening Reviews performed on APEC14B1

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult COG trial (stdAges CHILD and ADULT; Step 1 age 12 months to 21 years). Strata (DIPG, DMG H3K27M-mutant, HGG H3K27-wildtype) are not registered arms, so biomarker arms left empty; DIPG and DMG strata closed 2025-02-14. H3K27M status defines strata (enrichment); absence of BRAF V600 and IDH1 mutation required for the non-pontine strata (enrichment, not candidate-matched to selinexor). Adults >=18 only eligible with H3K27M-mutant tumours. Glioblastoma named once in inclusion criteria as an example of biopsy-proven pontine HGG.
